issue_request: FHIR-46191 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for changing Questionnaire.item.linkId to code and carrying the same behavior to QuestionnaireResponse so linkIds would not allow leading/trailing whitespace or intervening whitespace other than single spaces.
initial_application: The Jira application comment narrowed the implementation: changing to code would require an inappropriate binding, so the datatype stayed string and the code regex was copied as explicit constraints. Commit 5000586d1b0d7c0c4c488541b3574fef0c9d3739, referenced by Jira as f0c9d3739, added the Questionnaire regex extension and the que-16/qrs-3 linkId constraints.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The cited Zulip thread records the original concern about leading/trailing and confusing intervening whitespace while preserving legitimate slash-containing linkIds, and the SDC minutes record FHIR-46191 approval. The same historical commit also mentions FHIR-48941, but that issue concerns separate Questionnaire definition-cardinality behavior.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because Questionnaire.item.linkId and QuestionnaireResponse.item.linkId are both still string and both enforce the regex [^\s]+( [^\s]+)* through current constraints.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same historical implementation commit, but it concerns separate Questionnaire definition cardinality changes and was not needed to decide FHIR-46191.
